{{Quote
|Hr = Journal
|Obese offshoot of Muckroaches, born of the Citadel's exhaust smog. The winged roach's sagging stomach is filled with sizzling bile.<hr/>
Its form is absurd... Surely it should not be able to hold itself in the air? The noxious gases in its stomach must provide its levity.
}}
<b>Bloatroaches</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are giant, floating relatives of the [[Muckroach]] mutated by the [[Exhaust Organ]]'s smog.

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Bloatroaches float in the air, moving from their position only slightly. When in range, they attack by vomiting a cone of acid at [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]]. Contact with the acid projectiles or the Bloatroach itself deals {{Damage|2}}. When approached, they float slowly backwards. They are immune to spikes.

Bloatroaches can only aim their acid attack straight ahead and are incapable of attacking anything directly above or below them. Because of their size, they are easy to approach with the [[Clawline]] and Needle bounce off of repeatedly, as long as their backwards movement is followed. Their acid has extreme range and care should be taken when evading  them to avoid catching stray projectiles.

=== Act 3 ===
[[Black-Threading|Black-threaded]] Bloatroaches have their health doubled. They gain one of the following [[Black-Threading#Movesets|void attacks]]: Void Blades, Void Tendrils, or Void Projectiles.
